labels: Historical replay of frozen models. Illustrative. Not a live track record.
Out-of-sample windows were opened once, after the model freeze was committed.
meta.spike_note: Spike = price > 100 EUR/MWh (project threshold). Flag = top-decile tree disagreement (gbt vs rf).

label_definitions.in-sample: Evaluation window used during development; no model changes were committed between this run and the later out-of-sample run.
label_definitions.out-of-sample: One-shot holdout opened after the freeze commit; scored once.
label_definitions.explore: Window used to select or change the models that later ran on the holdout.

SE3_EXP.name: Sweden SE3 (explore 2015–2018)
SE3_EXP.label: explore
SE3_EXP.note: SE explore folds selected the GBT/RF parameters that later ran on the SE holdout — the models were changed on this window.

EE_EXP.name: Estonia (explore 2015–2018)
EE_EXP.label: in-sample
EE_EXP.note: FI/SE-frozen parameters evaluated on EE 2015–2018; nothing was changed before the EE holdout opened.

FI_H1.name: Finland (holdout 2021–2022)
FI_H1.label: out-of-sample
FI_H1.note: One-shot holdout; none of the models beat B1 (level-aware linear) on common hours.

FI_H2.name: Finland (holdout2 2025–2026)
FI_H2.label: out-of-sample
FI_H2.note: Spike-hour primary criterion: S-family FAIL vs B1; C-family undershoots spikes; recorded in results/holdout2_2025_2026.md.
